items.name: V-Cube Spiel A 2023
items.information:
V-Cubes is proud to bring back cubing competitions to Spiel Messe in Essen!
**Note:** V-Cube Spiel A 2023 is a series competition to V-Cube Spiel B 2023 on the same weekend. Please note that you may only register for one of the two competitions.

V-Cubes ist stolz darauf, wieder Speedcubing-Turniere auf der SPIEL Messe in Essen präsentieren zu dürfen!
**Wichtig:** V-Cube Spiel A 2023 ist eine Partner-Competition von V-Cube Spiel B 2023, die am gleichen Wochenende stattfindet. Bitte beachte, dass du dich nur für eines der beiden Turniere anmelden darfst. 

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbDRkIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ef25795363481ab9b918d882fa96ca2c55097150/v-cube.png)

To participate in this competition, you must have a ticket for Saturday at the Essen Spiel Messe exposition.  This ticket needs to be bought individually and is not included in the registration fee.
The competition will take place at Hall 5, Booth 5A108. You can see the site plan of Messe Essen [here](https://www.messe-essen.de/media/neue-medien/dreiklang/anreise-parkplaetze-downloads/gelaendeplaene/messe_essen_gelaendeplan.pdf).

If you are a new competitor, take a look at the corresponding tab. All competitors should be familiar with the information in the tab.

Um an diesem Wettbewerb teilnehmen zu können, brauchst du ein Ticket für den Samstag der Essen Spiel Messe. Dieses Ticket muss individuell erworben werden und ist nicht im Eintrittspreis enthalten.
Das Turnier findet in Halle 5 am Stand 5A108 statt. Den Geländeplan der Messe Essen findest du [hier](https://www.messe-essen.de/media/neue-medien/dreiklang/anreise-parkplaetze-downloads/gelaendeplaene/messe_essen_gelaendeplan.pdf).

Wenn du ein neuer Teilnehmer bist, wirf einen Blick auf den zugehörigen Tab. Alle Teilnehmer sollten mit den Informationen vertraut sein.

items.name: Half Turns Hataitai 2023

venue.name: [Hataitai Centre](https://hataitai.org.nz/hataitai-centre)
venue.address: Hataitai Centre, 157 Hataitai Road, Hataitai, Wellington, 6021

items.information:
Half Turns Hataitai 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. It is focused on some of the more mentally demanding events, that are given less of a focus in normal competitions - blindfolded and fewest moves solving, specifically.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience or skill. There will also be event-based time limits in place, to ensure we stay on schedule, especially given the time taken by fewest moves solving. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

**The main event of this competition is Fewest Moves**

items.name: Colorado Pastacomp 2023
items.information:
The space for this competition is provided by the Hilton Garden Inn and Johnny's Italian Steakhouse - lunch from the steakhouse will be provided to all competitors and one guest each (hence the larger registration fees). More details on this will be provided closer to the competition, but it should include pasta, barbeque, potatoes, etc. **Please comment the name of your guest when you register. This is not final and can be changed.**

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:15 AM.
